newsitem.title: UK: Article 19 rights group sends delegation to Albania.
newsitem.headline: Article 19 rights group sends delegation to Albania.

text.p: Article 19, a human rights pressure group, said on Tuesday it has sent a fact-finding delegation to Albania following the government's clampdown on the media and its declaration of a state of emergency.
The British-based group, also known as the International Centre Against Censorship, said the crisis in Albania did not excuse the imposition of what it called draconian censorship measures.

"We greatly fear that the government is deliberately targeting the media because it has been a vocal critic and to prevent reporting about the protest and the actions taken by the government to supress them," Frances D'Souza, its executive director said in a statement.
"We want to see the situation on the ground for ourselves and demonstrate our support for free and independent media," D'Souza added.

Article 19 said emergency legislation introduced by Albania was unclear about the details of censorship imposed on journalists. The group said it would try to meet government officials to remind them of what it called their obligations under international law.
"There can be no genuine democracy without media freedom," said D'Souza, who will lead the three-member delegation to Albania.

After weeks of unrest sparked by the collapse of fraudulent investment schemes, officials issued orders to shoot armed rioters on sight, imposed a dusk-to-dawn curfew and curbed press freedoms after parliament declared a state of emergency.
Article 19 said it was concerned that these measures might be aimed at suppressing democratic debate and any public calls for the government's resignation.
It called on the government to respect the fundamental right to freedom of expression and information and to take all possible steps to ensure that members of the media were protected.
The group is named after Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights which guarantees the right of freedom of speech and expression.
